notes.title: Demo version, now available!
notes.notes:
Hello! I am Hinawajin.


A demo version of MOONMAN is now available!
In this trial version, you can play up to stage 3.
It's an easy-to-play volume, so please give it a try!

We would appreciate it if you could tweet us your impressions of the game in the comments section here or on Twitter with the hashtag #MOONMAN!
Screenshot your time when you clear the game and let's compete for time among players!


Keep up the good work MOONMAN!

Click here for an explanatory video of MOONMAN↓.
